data.name: Staybridge Suites Villahermosa by IHG
data.address: Prol. P.º Usumacinta 1504 Col-Tabasco 2000, Multiochenta, 86035 Villahermosa, Tab., Mexico
data.description:
In a commercial area a 3-minute walk from the Carrizal River, this casual all-suite hotel is 2 km from Highway 180, 3 km from outdoor exhibits at La Venta Museum Park and 4 km from Villahermosa Cathedral.
The laid-back suites have kitchens, dining tables and living areas, as well as free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs.
Parking and a breakfast buffet are complimentary. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, a gym and guest laundry facilities.
